CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   C. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Work has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   C. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.

9. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   B. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Bible as a Guide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain King Solomon the wise ruler and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Noah and his sons and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. B — Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
